title: Index scan components
caption: The planner picks an index, the executor calls it only through the generic index API, btree finds TIDs, and the table AM turns each TID into a visible heap row.

title: One index lookup, step by step
caption: Follow the numbers to see a query for id = 42 travel from planner to btree to the heap and back to the client.

badges.meaning: Planner costs the index path with cost_index and picks it
Executor (IndexNext) opens the scan with index_beginscan
btree walks from the root to the leaf page via _bt_first
The index hands back a TID, stored in xs_heaptid
The heap table AM reads the page and finds the visible row version
Executor rechecks quals if needed and sends the row to the client

title: Anatomy of a btree page
caption: An 8kB index page holds a header, line pointers, free space, index tuples that carry TIDs, and a special area with the sibling links.
